title: fix(app-shell): Details and the catalog read a package the runtime refused to load as not loaded (objectui#11760)
body:
Fixes #11760
Clause-②: no

The install-local listing marks a package this runtime refused to load at startup with `notLoaded: { code, requiredRange }` (objectstack PR #21833, `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). Installed Apps reads that marker since objectui#11645 (PR objectui#11759). This PR makes the other faces read it too. Before, all of them told an operator that a refused package was installed and running.

Implemented by the dispatched dev on `claude/issue-11760-not-loaded-other-faces`, session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.

## What changes

| Face | Before, for a `notLoaded` entry | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Details header (`MarketplacePackagePage`, `localInstalledBadge`), catalog view and offline local view | green "Installed · vX" | outline "vX" + destructive "Not loaded", and the reason line beneath the badges |
| Details' own Uninstall (`doUninstallLocal`) | confirm `marketplace.uninstall.confirm`, result `successInDetail` ("remains loaded … until the next restart") | `confirmNotLoaded` / `successNotLoaded` |
| Catalog card (`MarketplacePage`, `installedByManifestId`) | green "Installed vX" | outline "vX" + destructive "Not loaded" |
| "Your organization" card on the same page (`installedIds`) | green "Installed" | destructive "Not loaded" (still no Install button: it is installed) |

- A loaded entry renders exactly as before on every face (measured below, byte for byte).
- No new key, export, prop or type member. Every text is one objectui#11645 added: `marketplace.notLoaded.badge`, `.protocolIncompatible`, `.otherReason`, `marketplace.uninstall.confirmNotLoaded`, `.successNotLoaded`. `marketplace.versionBadge` already existed.
- Files: the two pages, two new pin files beside them, one changeset. Nothing outside the claim's file surface.

### Decisions the dispatch left to the dev

- **Shape.** I followed Installed Apps' row: the version as an outline badge, then the destructive "Not loaded" badge, then (on Details) the reason line. The green badge carried the installed version, so keeping it beside "Not loaded" loses nothing. On the catalog view of Details and on a catalog card the catalog's latest version badge stays where it was, so a second "vX" can appear. It is the installed one, next to "Not loaded".
- **The reason line is on Details only.** A catalog card is a compact click-through, and Details (one click away) carries the reason. The code-to-sentence mapping is the one Installed Apps uses (`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` names the range; any other code is named by `otherReason`).
- **`successInDetail` vs `successNotLoaded`.** Read both in `en.ts`: the only Details-specific wording in `successInDetail` is "cached manifest for", inside the restart sentence that the not-loaded case drops. Nothing Details-specific is lost, so no new key.
- **The org card is the fourth "Installed" on the catalog page.** The card names the catalog card (`installedByManifestId`). The org section of the same page badges a local install "Installed" through `installedIds`, which reads the same listing. Org packages have no public listing, so for them the org card IS the catalog's face. It is the same defect class, in a claimed file, with the same key, fixed mechanically in the shape this PR pins. Its own pin and control are below. If the reviewer reads it as beyond the card, dropping it is one ternary and two test cases.

## Tests

New pins, both driven by the listing body the server serves (unmocked `marketplaceApi` over a stubbed `fetch`, the refused entry in objectstack PR #21833's wire shape: marker present, `withSampleData` absent), through the real `I18nProvider` in en and zh, with expected text read from the packs:

- `MarketplacePackagePage.notLoadedHeader-11760.test.tsx` (17 cases): header and Uninstall, catalog view and offline local view, en and zh, each with a loaded-entry control (green "Installed · vX", no reason line, `confirm` / `successInDetail`), plus an unknown refusal code.
- `MarketplacePage.notLoadedBadge-11760.test.tsx` (8 cases): catalog card and org card, en and zh, each with a loaded control.

Runs, from the worktree root:

- The two new files: 25 passed (17 + 8).
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` at `91c70b3`: `Test Files 1056 passed | 1 skipped (1057)`, `Tests 10342 passed | 9 skipped (10351)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (held 53m56s on a shared box).
- `91c70b3` is the head before I merged `main` (`d50f724`) as the dispatch asks. That merge brings in only `main`'s own landed commits. None of them touches these files, and the diff of `b67f24f` against `main` is exactly this PR's five files. The lock-bound reruns at `b67f24f` (dependency rebuild, type-check, the marketplace tests) are NOT MEASURED locally: the lock was held by another dev's full app-shell suite for more than 30 minutes. CI runs them on this head.

Type-check at `91c70b3`: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (script name echoed as `type-check`, after building the dependency closure with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, exit 0). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new test files (control: `marketplaceDates.displayLocale-10331.test.tsx` listed).

### Reverse verification, one face at a time

From committed `da68b10`, each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once, on-disk blob change proven, self-restoring with a trap, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Each leg replaced one face's `notLoaded` condition with `false`:

| Leg | Pins red | Everything else |
|---|---|---|
| Details header badge | 5 (header x 2 views x 2 langs, unknown code) | 12 green |
| Details reason line | the same 5 | 12 green |
| Details Uninstall confirm | 4 (Uninstall x 2 views x 2 langs) | 13 green |
| Details Uninstall result | the same 4 | 13 green |
| Catalog card | 2 (en, zh) | 6 green |
| Org card | 2 (en, zh) | 6 green |

All loaded-entry controls stayed green in every leg. After the run, both source blobs equal HEAD (`91ed0c30`, `0e29f945`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No dist leg: the tests import the pages by relative path, and `@object-ui/i18n` is aliased to `src` by `vitest.config.mts`.

### Loaded entries are byte-identical

A one-off probe (deleted, never committed) rendered every face over loaded entries only, at head and with the base `7b17705` blobs of both pages checked out, and compared `innerHTML`: Details catalog view (en 5038 bytes, zh 5040), Details offline view (en 4359, zh 4333), catalog page with a catalog card and an org card (en 12255, zh 12221). All six were `cmp`-identical to base.

## Gates

Re-run at `b67f24f` (lock-free), each exit 0, verdict line as printed:

- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK (scanned 7772 tracked text files)
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: OK
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: No pending changeset names a file this change touches.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: No test source names a pending changeset.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citation(s)
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`: OK
- `pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`: OK
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack
- `pnpm changeset:check`: no `major`; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 4 source files of 1 released package changed, 1 changeset declared
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (5 paths): NOT GOVERNED
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 4 touched `.tsx` files: 4 results, 0 errors, 13 warnings, none on a line this diff adds. All 4 files are in eslint's population (`isPathIgnored` false), and the resolved config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so the diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

At `91c70b3`: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0, and the full app-shell suite above.

Not run locally: the locale-pack gates (`check:i18n-drift`, `-dead-keys`, `-designer-parity`), because no pack changed; `check:readme-exports`, because no export changed; `check:sdui-registration-pins` and `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, which need a console build, because no registration and no import changed. `scripts/__tests__/vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts` names these two paths but reads only `AppContent.tsx` and the package manifest, neither touched. It is NOT MEASURED (two lock queue timeouts, exit 99), and CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- The code-to-sentence reading of the marker now lives in two places: `InstalledListWidget` (`notLoadedReason`) and `MarketplacePackagePage` (same name). A later refusal code needs both edited. `InstalledListWidget.tsx` is outside this card, so the two were not merged into one helper. Observation only, not filed. Carrier: none.
- Read from source and through the tests above. Not reproduced through a running console against a real refused package.
